title: The Journalist
description: Nadia Voss, the Herald's political correspondent, has a story about the budget process. She's offering you a chance to shape it before it publishes. She's also testing whether your government is actually different.

title: Budget Allocation — Final Adjustments
description: The vote of no confidence is approaching. Your budget is your record. Make sure it tells the story you want parliament to hear.

title: The Vote — Final Preparations
description: Kolvar filed the motion this morning. The Speaker has scheduled debate for next week. You need 58 votes. Vyktor's count says you have 54. The speech will matter.

title: Kravenstal — Implementation Review
description: The emergency measures you authorized are being implemented. Or not — depending on which ministry you ask. Maric says Vostane is blocking the relief funds. Vostane says Maric never submitted the paperwork.

title: Constitutional Reform — Preliminary Review
description: Theron has requested a pre-vote meeting. He's worried that if the no-confidence motion succeeds, the constitutional draft dies with your government.

title: Army Day
description: General Brenner requests a full parade through Ashenmere for Army Day — armor, honor guard, air wing overhead. Colonel Dusek warns Tyvaren's border command will not read it as tradition.
